question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become the permanent public plugin SDK contract for transient tool progress?
rationale: A cross-plugin producer/transport seam is appropriate, but whether this exact marker and predicate become supported third-party API requires maintainer architecture intent rather than test-derived judgment.

options.title: Approve the generic contract
options.body: Keep the narrow marker and predicate with semantics explicitly limited to transient, non-terminal tool progress.

options.title: Keep the intent internal
options.body: Redesign the ownership seam so bundled Codex and Slack share the signal without creating a supported third-party SDK export.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow marker and predicate with semantics explicitly limited to transient, non-terminal tool progress.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing progress marker and adjacent Codex/Slack delivery architecture trace to this current-main history.
